SENSORIUM. [2] [Cocc. s.]
Slight vertigo after cessation of toothache.
Disappearance of pain in face attended by fainting, oppressed breathing, subdued intermittent pulse. θ Toothache.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cocc. s.]
Pressure and heaviness in forehead. θ Neuralgia.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cocc. s.]
Pressure and heaviness, especially over r. eye, which is sensitive to least touch. θ Neuralgia.
During whole paroxysm, cannot open eyes, pain < by any bright object. θ Neuralgia.
Eyelids open with difficulty, light increases pain. θ Neuralgia.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cocc. s.]
Pain over whole side of right face, suddenly jumping to left side, after use of lancet. θ Toothache.
Pain in course of frontal nerve, becoming more and more severe. θ Neuralgia.
Pain extending over whole face, even to hairy scalp. θ Periodical toothache.
Chronic pain extending from superior molars to forehead ; affected part paler ; attack lasts only about one minute ; but is instantly repeated ; < at night, preventing sleep for many weeks.
Frontal neuralgia, attack commencing by a pressure and heaviness in forehead, especially over right eye, which was sensitive to least touch ; attack lasts six to twelve hours, ending in a general heat and sleep of two to three hours, at end of which he awoke without the least pain ; paroxysms returning every eight, twelve, fourteen or twenty-one days.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Cocc. s.]
Periodical toothache, coming on every day at noon in third inferior molar, extending over whole face, even to hairy scalp.
Raging toothache during day, almost entirely disappearing at night, sleep sound and undisturbed.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cocc. s.]
Loss of appetite. θ Neuralgia.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cocc. s.]
With disappearance of pain in face breathing becomes oppressed. θ Toothache.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cocc. s.]
Subdued, intermittent pulse, with remission of pain in face. θ Toothache.
Contracted pulse. θ Toothache.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Cocc. s.]
Icy cold extremities. θ Neuralgia.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cocc. s.]
Is much weakened by long-continued suffering. θ Toothache.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cocc. s.]
Nocturnal attacks of toothache, entirely preventing sleep, even when pain did not appear at night, could not sleep.
Attack ends in a general heat and sleep of two or three hours, from which he awakes without any pain. θ Neuralgia.
   

SKIN. [46] [Cocc. s.]
Skin of whole body moist and cold. θ Neuralgia.
